patterns.note: Sections are defined by full-bleed, vibrant color blocks that alternate between a bright coral/orange and a sunny yellow, creating distinct visual breaks.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, contrasted with smaller, more detailed body text and occasional mono-spaced accents for data or labels.
Content is primarily centered within full-width, full-height sections, often featuring a single dominant illustration or interactive element that fills a significant portion of the screen.

As the user scrolls, new sections slide into view with a full-screen transition, often accompanied by elements within the new section animating or revealing themselves (e.g., the phone sliding in, characters appearing).
A 'MENU' button remains sticky at the bottom center of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent navigation access without obscuring main content.
Custom, playful, geometric character illustrations are central to many sections, acting as visual anchors and conveying the brand's personality and messaging.

technique_notes: Sections are designed as full-viewport height containers that snap or smoothly transition into view on scroll, creating a distinct 'page-turn' effect. This is likely achieved with scroll-snapping or a custom scroll-jacking library.

Elements within each section, such as 3D objects (phone, globe) and custom illustrations, are revealed or animated into their final positions as their respective section enters the viewport. This uses a combination of CSS keyframes for simpler animations and potentially canvas or Lottie for more complex interactive elements like the globe or character animations.
The persistent 'MENU' button at the bottom of the screen is a fixed element, ensuring navigation is always accessible without obscuring content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) are used for impact, with body text being legible and smaller labels using a distinct monospace font.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for section blocks and UI elements, with a notable exception for the pill-shaped CTA button.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing is used throughout, with generous padding around content blocks and illustrations, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly saturated, two-tone color palette (coral and yellow) combined with a unique, playful illustration style featuring geometric characters and objects. This creates a vibrant, almost whimsical brand identity that stands apart from typical financial services sites.
